title: The Emperor's Ring
subtitle: A Holiday in Lucknow Turns Perilous
summary: When Feluda joins a family trip to the historic city of Lucknow, a seemingly ordinary holiday quickly takes a mysterious turn. As secrets from the city's royal past come to light, Feluda's sharp intellect is put to the ultimate test. Dive into a world where every corner hides a clue, and danger lurks just beneath the surface.
